figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

M01.note: Same recording protocol as the lineage [@grosz2018f0].

M03.note: About 15 minutes of recordings in total; CNN hyperparameters taken from an earlier MGC-LSP optimization.

M04.note: No silent articulation is tested, as in its lineage.

M05.note: Single frame by choice; five frames gave higher V/U accuracy in [@grosz2018f0].

M06.note: Parametric vocoder like the field at the time; the lineage replaced it with mel-spectrogram plus WaveGlow a year later [@csapo2020waveglow] [later].

choice: Continuous F0 plus MVF, no voicing flag
M08.note: Interpolated F0 targets are prior [@liu2016articulatory; @gonzalez2017evaluation; @taguchi2018articulatory]; carrying voicing by MVF instead of the flag is new to articulatory input, but its effect is not shown.

M11.note: Baseline and proposed are scored against different reference F0 contours (Sec. 4.2).

M12.note: No intelligibility test, against 11 prior studies with one (best comparable work: [@taguchi2018articulatory]); the F0 RMSE comparison mixes reference contours; no listening difference is significant.

M13.note: Real-time feasibility is asserted (Sec. 5) without latency or hardware figures.
